app.description: Path of the DevTools app (relative to the workspace root, or absolute).

python.description: Path of the Python interpreter for scripts.

scripts_dir.description: Directory of the scripts (relative to the workspace root, or absolute).

editor.description:
The command that opens a source location; `{file}`, `{line}` and `{column}` are replaced.
Empty means the default.

KeyConfig.description: Keys that open DevTools (`"Ctrl+Shift+I"` style chords). `None` means the default; `[]` disables.

pick.description: Chords that open DevTools in pick mode.
